scope: Local synthetic feasibility only; no official data, heldout queries, production routing or durable formats
uneven_counts: For every case, block sizes alternate n and n/4; query counts remain equal per block
coherent: One Gaussian lobe per block, random center radius scale3, row/query noise0.25
multimodal: Two equally occupied opposite lobes per block; radius8; row/query noise0.25; centroid cancellation
mixed: All blocks share standard normal population; queries standard normal
rare: 32 orthogonal radius12 query centers; each block has10 near rows per own query (noise0.001), remaining rows form radius0.75 clouds for preceding block queries (noise0.001); true nearest neighbors are sparse within their block

capacity_probe.model: Independent uniform phases; one unit member signal; compare measured noise SD with sqrt(n/(2D)); extrapolation is labeled theoretical

mutation_checks: Add/delete/replace/reuse against independent full resummation; counts0/1, duplicate coordinates, empty blocks, invalid shape/nonfinite input/negative population
candidate_for_further_work: One fixed width/bandwidth/score form must achieve coverage>=0.9975 at fanout4 for every coherent/multimodal/rare case and projection seed, while its mean multimodal coverage exceeds centroid by>=0.10. Mixed cases and oracle ceilings remain reported. Passing only licenses a separate preregistered development proposal, never production retention.
timing: Warmup then5 samples, BLAS threads2; local exploratory timings only, no performance-retention claim
memory: Per-array geometry bounded; live numerical working set budget512MiB; report header/projection bytes and reservoir budget separately
failure_rule: Preserve every configuration/loss; no grid/seed/scenario retuning after outputs; stop on correctness error
